content_blocks.label: clause_1._DEFINITION_OF_CONFIDENTIAL_INFORMATION
content_blocks.text: ‘Confidential Information’ means all information disclosed by the Disclosing Party, whether written, oral, electronic, or otherwise, that is marked or designated as confidential or proprietary.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_OBLIGATIONS_OF_THE_RECEIVING_PARTY
content_blocks.text: The Receiving Party agrees to maintain the confidentiality of the Confidential Information and shall not disclose such information to any third party without the prior written consent of the Disclosing Party.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._TERM
content_blocks.text: This Agreement shall remain in effect indefinitely until all Confidential Information has been made public through no fault of the Receiving Party.

content_blocks.label: notary_note
content_blocks.text: Sworn before me this 20th day of July 2024.
